candidates.description: This vector activates for words, roots, and affixes related to oversight, management, provision, and administrative control.
This vector represents academic achievement, education, and graduation-related terms.
This vector represents titles and terms associated with academia and higher education.
This vector represents geographic regions, nationalities, and continents.
This feature activates on the root morphemes, stems, or common subword prefixes of Latin- and Romance-derived vocabulary across multiple languages.
This vector represents the root or common prefix "doc" and its variants across multiple languages, frequently associated with medical or document-related terminology.
This vector represents elite universities and higher education institutions.
This vector represents adjectives describing temporal characteristics, frequency, or conventional status.
This feature vector activates strongly on common Portuguese grammatical words, articles, pronouns, and prepositions.
This feature vector activates on tokens containing Latin-derived numerical roots and morphologically similar name or prefix fragments.
